en:
Welcome to the comprehensive class mod All Classes

This mode offers a choice of 13 new classes, plenty of new traits and items. Here is a description of the properties of each class.
The mod was reworked for Tábor servers
-DejFidOFF-

Alchemyst,
boundaries are meant to be crossed

Abilities:
• Transmutation Exclusively can produce sulfur
• Forager (+25% yield from wild crops, +50% chance for an additional find when gathering)
• Fleetfooted (+15% walking speed)
• Fasting (-20% hunger rate)
• Sluggish (-25% mining speed)


Artisan,
this world is yours to shape.

Abilities:
• Artifice (Has the ability to craft small carpets, also to craft a few paints)
• Pilferer
(+35% loot from cracked containers, chance for a double drop of the sharp wheel, 25% chance to obtain a whole cracked container, -20% hunger rate)
• Rugged (+5 health points)
• Nervous (-50% armor durability, -20% melee damage)


Chef,
you are the master of your food.

Abilities:
• Culinary (Has the ability to craft various metal cooking pots and old-fashioned dried aged beef.)
• Butcher (+25% loot from animals, +50% faster butchering of animals)
• Fasting (-20% hunger rate)
• Exhausted (-35% ranged damage, -35% projectile acceleration, -20% ranged accuracy, -30% slower ranged weapons)
• Clumsy (-25% armor durability)


Homesteader,
your fields are full of wealth.

Abilities:
• Pioneer (Can extract seeds from crops, produce fertile soil and universal fertilizer to boost fertility)
• Farmer (+30% extra yield when harvesting planted crops)
• Rugged (+5 health points)
• Butcher (+25% loot from animals, +50% faster butchering of animals)
• Petrophobia (No chance to obtain double ore, -25% mining speed)


Lumberjack,
the wilderness is your kingdom and your greatest resource.

Abilities:
• Carpenter (Can craft Sleek Doors, wagon wheels, wallpapers and cheaper firewood, boards, Lumberjack Axe and Sticks)
• Lumberjack (+10% chance for an extra log, double yield from fruit trees, double seed drop rate from trees, +50% chance to obtain twice as many sticks from branches)
• Scavenger (+20% yield from wild crops, +30% chance for an additional find when gathering)
• Rugged (+5 health points)
• Inaccurate (-25% ranged damage, -20% ranged accuracy, -25% range, -15% slower ranged weapons)


Mason,
every construction is your canvas.

Abilities:
• Mason (Produces mortar, plaster, fire-resistant material and other raw bricks at lower cost, can directly produce stone blocks from stones and has access to brown clay bricks.
• Defender (+10% melee damage, +20% armor durability, and +20% less penalty for moving in armor, -20% hunger rate)
• Rockhound (+22.5% additional chance to obtain double ore, +50% mining speed)
• Rugged (+5 health points)
• Heavy-footed (+20% distance at which animals detect you)


Merchant,
you control the economy and that is your kingdom.

Abilities:
• Mercantile (Exclusively can produce LV Handbag with 15 slots for items, Pirate Gold Coins or Rusty Gears
• Sneaky (-60% distance at which animals detect you, +15% walking speed)
• Squeamish (-25% loot from wild animals, -10% slower butchering of animals)


Miner,
the secrets of the rocks are revealed to you.

Abilities:
• Prospector (Produces rock bombs at a lower cost, a primitive recipe for blasting powder, and makes waterproof mine lamps)
• Miner (+50% additional chance to obtain double ore, +100% mining speed)
• Exhausted (-35% ranged damage, -35% projectile acceleration, -20% ranged accuracy, -30% slower ranged weapons)


Mystic,
the secrets of the universe are in your head!

Abilities:
• Transcription (Has the ability to produce small carpets and also parchment from hemp, papyrus, and straw, and can also create a butterfly.)
• Scavenger (+20% yield from wild crops, +30% chance for an additional find when gathering)
• Sneaky (-60% distance at which animals detect you, +15% walking speed)
• Pilferer (+35% loot from cracked containers, chance for a double drop of the sharp wheel, 25% chance to obtain a whole cracked container, -20% hunger rate)
• Careless (No chance to obtain double ore)
• Clumsy (-25% armor durability)


Ranger,
the natural order is your goal.

Abilities:
• Sentry (Has the ability to easily produce a bows and also primitive arrows.)
• Sharpeye (+100% ranged damage, +50% projectile acceleration, +25% faster ranged weapons, most accurate.)
• Defender (+10% melee damage, +20% armor durability, and +20% less penalty for moving in armor, -20% hunger rate)
• Furtive (-25% distance at which animals detect you)
• Squeamish (-25% loot from wild animals, -10% slower butchering of animals)
• Petrophobia (No chance to obtain double ore, -25% mining speed)


Smith,
the ore of the world finds life in your hands.

Abilities:
• Smith (Can use tool sets for repairing armor and shields, create metal pans, and produce cheaper ore bombs and blasting powder)
• Defender (+10% melee damage, +20% armor durability, and +20% less penalty for moving in armor, -20% hunger rate)
• Burner (+35% chance to obtain double wooden coal from wooden kilns)
• Heavyhanded (-20% loot from cracked containers, 20% chance for a lesser find when gathering, -20% yield from wild crops)


Medic,
you bring healing where it is needed most.

Abilities:
• Stitch doctor (Can craft a sewing kit or Tailored armor)
• Field medic (Can craft a Grass and Flower Poultice.)
• Rugged (+5 health points)
• Mender (+25% armor durability)
• Civil (-25% loot from wild animals, -15% slower butchering of animals, 15% chance for a lesser find when gathering, -15% yield from wild crops)


Tinker,
no challenge is too difficult.

Abilities:
• Crafty (Has the ability to craft metal parts and also the ability to create a scrap weapon kit, chute and mechanical parts with higher efficiency)
• Tinkerer Exclusive craftable device to tame locusts
• Technical (Lower cost for repairing translocators, +50% damage against mechanical damage)
• Fleetfooted (+15% walking speed)
• Rockhound (+22.5% additional chance to obtain double ore, +50% mining speed)
• Civil (-25% loot from wild animals, -15% slower butchering of animals, 15% chance for a lesser find when gathering, -15% yield from wild crops)

en: Walking Sticks A trusty companions for your rusty knees. Walking sticks are handheld items that provide passive bonuses while equipped. Every stick improves your walking speed and reduces hunger drain, while some variants come with a unique ability tied to their purpose. All walking sticks feature a custom walk animation and an auto-step feature that helps you traverse uneven terrain without jumping. Variants range from the simple Crude walking stick, easily crafted on the go, to more unique options like the Blackguard spearstaff which can be thrown and provides much needed aid on long marches, or the cozy Witch's variant that casts a warm comforting light which can also be used to light a fire. Speaking of fire, the terrifying Jonas ash-spitter flamethrower fueled by temporal gears is also at your disposal. Some sticks support attachments. For example, the Base walking stick can hold a lantern made of any metal, quartz glass with no lining, or alternatively a cow skull, while the Fine walking stick can be used to craft a Pathfinder's walking stick, Gas lantern variant, a Shepherd's axe, or the Architect's walking stick. Those who wish to remain hidden, or perhaps have a little mischievous intent may be interested in a Cane with hidden blade or a Cane with hidden gearlock. Several sticks can also be attached to the side of your elk. Check each variant's handbook entry for detailed stats and crafting recipes. May the road rise to meet your steps, traveller.
fr: Bâtons de marche Des compagnons de confiance pour vos genoux fatigués. Les bâtons de marche sont des objets à main qui fournissent des bonus passifs lorsqu'ils sont équipés. Chaque bâton améliore votre vitesse de marche et réduit la consommation de faim, tandis que certaines variantes sont dotées d'une capacité unique liée à leur utilité. Tous les bâtons de marche disposent d'une animation de marche personnalisée et d'une fonction d'auto-escalade qui vous aide à traverser des terrains inégaux sans sauter. Les variantes vont du simple bâton de marche primitif, facilement créé en chemin, à des options plus uniques comme le bâton-lance Blackguard qui peut être lancé et fournit une aide bien utile lors de longues marches, ou la confortable variante de sorcière qui projette une lumière douce et réconfortante et peut aussi être utilisée pour allumer un feu. Parlant de feu, le terrifiant Jonas crache-cendre lance-flammes alimenté par des engrenages temporels est aussi à votre disposition. Certains bâtons soutiennent des accessoires. Par exemple, le bâton de marche basique peut accueillir une lanterne faite de n'importe quel métal, du verre de quartz sans doublure, ou une alternative un crâne de vache, tandis que le bâton de marche fin peut être utilisé pour créer un bâton de marche du Pathfinder, une variante lampe à gaz, une hache de berger, ou le bâton de marche d'architecte. Ceux qui souhaitent rester cachés, ou peut-être ont une petite intention malveillante pourraient être intéressés par une canne avec lame cachée ou une canne avec mécanisme d'engrenage caché. Plusieurs bâtons peuvent aussi être attachés au côté de votre cerf. Vérifiez l'entrée du manuel de chaque variante pour les statistiques détaillées et les recettes d'artisanat. Que le chemin vienne à la rencontre de vos pas, voyageur.

fr: Aussi connu sous le nom de ciupaga, valaška, ou fokos dans les régions montagneuses. Une combinaison de bâton de marche et d'outil polyvalent forestier, il aide à dégager les broussailles devant et fournit une protection si nécessaire.

en: A combination of a walking stick and a heavy-duty sling for ranged combat. Uses common stones as ammunition.
fr: Une combinaison d'un bâton de marche et d'une fronde robuste pour le combat à distance. Utilise des pierres communes comme munitions.

en: A charming walking aid that casts a warm, comforting light, easing the traveler’s burden with every step. Useful for starting fires.
fr: Un bâton de marche charmant qui projette une lumière douce et réconfortante, soulageant le fardeau du voyageur à chaque pas. Utile pour allumer des feux.

en: Traditional Japanese garden lantern, also known as buried lanterns. Oribe-Gata is the most famous design of Ikekomi-Gata. Distinctive shape with a wide, flared top and a narrower base, often decorated with geometric patterns or floral motifs. Designed to be embedded or inserted into the ground.
fr: Lanterne traditionnelle de jardin japonais, également connue sous le nom de lanternes enfouies. Oribe-Gata est le design le plus célèbre d'Ikekomi-Gata. Forme distinctive avec un sommet large et évasé et une base plus étroite, souvent décorée de motifs géométriques ou floraux. Conçue pour être encastrée ou insérée dans le sol.

en: Traditional Japanese garden lantern, often called 'snow-viewing lanterns'. These low, squat lanterns have wide, flat tops designed to collect snow. Snow lanterns are so named as the generous diameter of the top lid protects the fire box underneath. This attractive granite lantern is most often used in oriental water basin arrangements and needs to be chosen with care to match the proportions of the water basin used.
fr: Lanterne traditionnelle de jardin japonais, souvent appelée « lanternes de visionnage de neige ». Ces lanternes basses et trapues ont des sommet larges et plats conçus pour collecter la neige. Les lanternes de neige sont ainsi nommées car le grand diamètre du dessus protège le foyer de feu en dessous. Cette élégante lanterne en granit est le plus souvent utilisée dans les arrangements de bassins d'eau orientaux et doit être choisie avec soin pour correspondre aux proportions du bassin d'eau utilisé.

en: Traditional Japanese temple lantern. 'Okunoin' refers to the sacred area deep within a shrine, where important or hidden Buddhist statues are enshrined. Lanterns placed in these secluded areas, are called Okunoin-style lanterns. Distinctive shape with a wide, flared top with 'warabites' and a decorated base, often decorated with geometric patterns or floral motifs.
fr: Lanterne traditionnelle de temple japonais. « Okunoin » désigne la zone sacrée au plus profond d'un sanctuaire, où se trouvent des statues bouddhistes importantes ou cachées. Les lanternes placées dans ces zones isolées s'appellent lanternes de style Okunoin. Forme distinctive avec un sommet large et évasé avec « warabites » et une base décorée, souvent ornée de motifs géométriques ou floraux.

Needs lots of cuddles, snackies and booping on the snuut.

Demands total world domination, fried chicken and a clean litterbox.
